name: Toluene disproportionation and transalkylation
principle: Toluene and heavier aromatics (C9+) are converted over a zeolite catalyst to benzene and mixed xylenes. UOP's Tatoray unit at Hengyi Brunei produces high-purity benzene and mixed xylenes feeding the paraxylene loop.

source.note: Oil & Gas Journal, Hengyi lets contract for aromatics expansion at Brunei complex, 25 February 2021

advantages: Converts surplus toluene and heavies into higher-value xylenes and benzene
limitations: Source gives no conversion or capacity figures for Tatoray

sources.note: Oil & Gas Journal, Hengyi lets contract for aromatics expansion at Brunei complex, 25 February 2021
